description: Added spring-cloud-azure.version property (5.22.0) and spring-cloud-azure-dependencies BOM in dependencyManagement with import scope. Spring Boot version is 3.2.1 (3.x), and the selected BOM version 5.22.0 meets the requirement of >=5.22.0 and <7.0.0 for Spring Boot 3.x projects.
Added com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency without an explicit version, correctly relying on the BOM defined in the parent pom.xml to manage the version.
Added com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency without an explicit version, correctly relying on the BOM defined in the parent pom.xml to manage the version.

Replaced password-based PostgreSQL datasource configuration with Azure Managed Identity passwordless authentication. Password property removed; datasource URL updated to use Azure PostgreSQL hostname with environment variables; passwordless-enabled, managed-identity-enabled and client-id properties added; all required instructional comments for sovereign cloud and service principal auth included.

issues.description: spring.cloud.azure.credential.client-id is set to the literal placeholder '<your_managed_identity_client_id>' rather than an environment variable (e.g., ${MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID}). While this matches the skill's example, all other dynamic values in the file use environment variable substitution. This value must be manually replaced before deployment, which may be overlooked.
